title: Coherent reflexive module of rank one on an integral scheme
statement: Let $Y$ be an integral scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-integral-scheme], with function field $k(Y)$ [def-sc-function-field], and let $F$ be an $\mathcal O_Y$-module. Say that $F$ is coherent reflexive of rank one if it is coherent [pqf-def-coherent], its canonical evaluation morphism $F\to\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_Y}(\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_Y}(F,\mathcal O_Y),\mathcal O_Y)$ is an isomorphism [def-pur-sheaf-hom], and its generic rank, the dimension of the stalk of $F$ at the generic point over $k(Y)$ [def-pc-module-torsion-generic-rank], is one.
